How to use this calculator

  1. Enter dating method, selected date.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How due date is calculated

LMP dating adds 280 days; conception dating adds 266 days; a day-5 embryo transfer adds 261 days. These are conventional estimates rather than a prediction of the delivery date. A day-5 embryo transfer on March 1 gives an estimated due date 261 days later.

EDD=LMP+280 d; conception+266 d; day-5 transfer+261 d.
A worked example

A day-5 embryo transfer on March 1 gives an estimated due date 261 days later.

Assumptions & useful context

Confirm dating with prenatal care; an estimated due date does not predict exact delivery day.

Health calculations are estimates for education. They cannot diagnose a condition or replace a clinician’s assessment. Individual needs vary, especially during pregnancy, illness and growth.

ACOG: Pregnancy dating and estimated due dates ↗

Frequently asked questions

Which date should I trust?

Use the date selected by your prenatal clinician, who can account for ultrasound and treatment details.

Does a due date mean labor begins that day?

No. It is a reference point for pregnancy dating.
